verses.gurmukhi: ਚਾਰਿ ਪਦਾਰਥ ਰਿਧਿ ਸਿਧਿ ਨਿਧਿ ਲਖ ਕਰੋੜੀ।
verses.translit_en: chaar padhaarath ridh sidh nidh lakh karoRee|

en.bdb: In all of the four ideals of life, riddhis, siddhis and myriads of treasures;

verses.gurmukhi: ਲਖ ਪਾਰਸ ਲਖ ਪਾਰਿਜਾਤ ਲਖ ਲਖਮੀ ਜੋੜੀ।
verses.translit_en: lakh paaras lakh paarijaat lakh lakhamee joRee|

en.bdb: Philosopher’s stones, wish fulfilling trees and many varieties of wealth are collected;
Myriads of fabulous gems supposed to yield anything desired and wish fulfilling cows are also added to all this;
Again invaluable jewels, pearls and diamonds are kept with all this;

verses.gurmukhi: ਲਖ ਕਵਿਲਾਸ ਸੁਮੇਰੁ ਲਖ ਲਖ ਰਾਜ ਬਹੋੜੀ।
verses.translit_en: lakh kavilaas sumer lakh lakh raaj bahoRee|

en.bdb: Myriads of kailas and Sumer mountains are also gathered together;

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖ ਫਲੁ ਪਿਰਮ ਰਸੁ ਮੁਲੁ ਅਮੁਲੁ ਸੁ ਥੋੜੀ ॥੯॥
verses.translit_en: gurmukh sukh fal piram ras mul amulu su thoRee ||9||

en.bdb: Even then they all have no standing at all before the invaluable elixir of love of the gurmukhs.
